column6: Consent: unnamed trib of Black Brook. OS OpenMap Local SurfaceWater_Line: the stream from Rochester Road runs north and meets the Rivelin here, 241 m below the plunge pool; the only streams meeting it above come from the south-west and pass no closer than 839 m to the outfall. The nearest drawn link was the Rivelin 709 m away, above the pool.

Consent: Harrow Beck via a surface water sewer. Lazonby's Neighbourhood Plan Design Guide (2018): the main street follows Harrow Beck from Townhead down to the River Eden, nearly 3/4 mile. OS OpenMap Local SurfaceWater_Line draws the beck 23 m from the outfall, running north-east, and its last reach meeting the Eden here, 435 m above the Lazonby swim spot; the reach between runs under the village and is not drawn. The nearest drawn link was the Eden 629 m away, 0.3 km above the spot.

Consent: Clifton Hampden Ditch. OS OpenMap Local SurfaceWater_Line draws the ditch leaving the works east-south-east (330 m), then after a 160 m gap a further 290 m heading east that stops 82 m short of the Thames. That line, extended, meets the Thames here, 21 m above the Clifton Hampden swim spot's pin; the nearest river point to its end is 7 m above it. Within map precision of the spot, so placed here and counted. The nearest drawn link was an unnamed channel 445 m away, 0.7 km above the spot.

Consent: River Wharfe. The outfall is 5 m from the Wharfe at Wilderness Carpark bathing water point (53.92655,-1.38542). It was snapped onto a 31 m stub of the Wharfe with no network above it, which joins the main channel 43 m below the point, so it was not counted. At 5 m the map cannot say which side of the point it is; an outfall at a bathing water's point counts, so it is placed on the main channel 7 m above it (OS Open Rivers link geometry).

Ilkley Middleton CSO, about 36 spills a year. The EA's bathing water profile for Wharfe at Cromwheel puts it just to the north of the compliance monitoring point, and the EA's own map point for it is 17 m upstream of it. It was snapped onto the next link, 20 m below the point, so it was not counted. Placed on the Wharfe 12 m above the point (OS Open Rivers link geometry), so it counts.

Abbey Mill CSO. The EA's bathing water profile for Nidd at the Lido places it just below the bottom weir, below the bathing water. Snapped 22 m below the sampling point; kept there, so it is not counted (a settled case, which the build's near-spot check would otherwise list).
